title: Ambiguous Coordinates
description: Generate all valid coordinate pairs by inserting a comma and possible decimal points into string s.
pseudocode:
1. For i from 1 to len(s)-2: 
2.   split s into parts X = s[1:i+1], Y = s[i+1:-1]
3.   generate all possible decimal versions of X and Y
4.   combine valid X and Y pairs into '(x, y)' format

steps.note: Initialize splitting the string '(123)' at various points.
Generate valid decimals: X can only be '1'. Y can be '23' or '2.3'.
Generate valid decimals: X can be '12' or '1.2'. Y can only be '3'.
